title: Python Object Setattr Failure
objective: Make object.__setattr__ reject unsuccessful host writes while preserving descriptor precedence

oracles: Ordinary setattr for native host writes; CPython for descriptor precedence and setter exceptions

handoff.summary: The final object.__setattr__ host fallback checks Reflect.set false and raises the existing ordinary-setattr AttributeError. Descriptor precedence, successful setter returns, thrown identities, and owned storage are unchanged. Three-line implementation diff adds 89 bytes; core source preflight is 899959/903000 bytes. The source oracle reproduces old silent failures and passes against corrected source before the frozen full build.
risks: Host freezing has no direct CPython equivalent; existing ordinary setattr supplies the host-write failure oracle.
This does not change namespace freezing policy or add global Reflect hooks.
next_steps: Qualify the frozen source with a full build, focused, portable, and strict suites; keep draft pending CI.
